Kirby no Pinball.name: Kirby's Pinball Land
Kirby no Pinball.summary: Choose your world and take aim! Kirby will be launched into the fast-paced danger of uncharted worlds, but you can help him face his foes head on. It's a pinball race to check out each new world's surprise enemies and pitfalls. Flip Kirby in battles against lethal eyeballs, a shooting tree and mace-swinging maniacs. Take aim and leap to new worlds!

Magic Knight Rayearth 2nd. - The Missing.name: Mahou Kishi Rayearth 2nd: The Missing Colors
Magic Knight Rayearth 2nd. - The Missing.summary: Mahou Kishi Rayearth 2nd: The Missing Colors is a Role-Playing game. The plot of the game is that Cefiro's Colors have been stolen by the Color Thief, you then have to go through the three structures to recapture the colors.
